We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we don't have the compound given. Possibly we need to get NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know the structure. Maybe the system expects we use carbon_nmr_spectra or proton_nmr_spectra to count methyl signals. However we need the sample at hand; maybe the environment already has a sample loaded. We can call carbon_nmr_spectra to get carbon NMR, then count methyl carbon signals (around 10-30 ppm). Or proton NMR to count methyl proton signals (singlet, doublet, etc). The cheapest is carbon NMR? Both cost. But we need to answer integer.

We don't know if the sample is defined. Likely the environment has a default compound. Let's try to get proton NMR first, as it directly shows methyl peaks. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool.
